main_screens.name: Welcome
main_screens.title: Good things happen nearby.
main_screens.copy: A confident first impression. Full-bleed portraits, bold type and a bright coral accent.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Start with the people whose paths cross yours.

main_screens.name: Phone number
main_screens.title: A number. A new beginning.
main_screens.copy: One phone number to sign up or sign in. No email, password, name or job title.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Phone number, then a six-digit verification code.

main_screens.name: Verification
main_screens.title: You are almost in.
main_screens.copy: A single code field supports typing and pasting. Change your number or request a new code.
main_screens.ruleCopy: This prototype does not send a real SMS.

main_screens.name: Your age & gender
main_screens.title: Your age. Your identity.
main_screens.copy: Your own age and gender are explicitly required. Who you want to meet is a separate next step.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Ages under 18 cannot continue. Ages 99 and older display as 99+.

main_screens.name: Dating preferences
main_screens.title: Your kind of connection.
main_screens.copy: Select multiple genders or Everyone. Set both age limits on one shared slider.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Drag the ends of a single age range from 18 to 99+.

main_screens.name: Your photos
main_screens.title: Four photos. All you.
main_screens.copy: Four photo slots, one clear next step. Add or change photos without filling out a long profile.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Discovery pauses if you remove a photo until all four are back.

main_screens.name: Location permission
main_screens.title: Let your paths cross.
main_screens.copy: The reason for location access is explained before asking for permission.

main_screens.name: Discover
main_screens.title: Make the first move.
main_screens.copy: Big photos. Clear actions. People you have crossed paths with, ready for a new connection.
main_screens.ruleCopy: About 20 metres apart. A two-hour privacy delay by default.

main_screens.name: How it works
main_screens.title: Small world. Good timing.
main_screens.copy: One short introduction after setup. Replay the story anytime from Profile, or explore its five chapters at your own pace.
main_screens.ruleCopy: A crossing, a mutual fit, a little time, and two people choosing to connect.

main_screens.name: Likes You
main_screens.title: Someone made a move.
main_screens.copy: Incoming likes have a dedicated place. Blurred previews for free members; clear profiles with Premium.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Free mutual matching and chat still work in Discover.

main_screens.name: Premium
main_screens.title: Less guessing. More connecting.
main_screens.copy: A focused subscription screen explains what unlocks, with monthly and annual example plans.
main_screens.ruleCopy: No payment is collected. Privacy delays always stay in place.

main_screens.name: Match
main_screens.title: The feeling is mutual.
main_screens.copy: Two likes, one clear next step. Start a conversation or keep exploring.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Like a profile that likes you back to try this moment.

main_screens.name: Chats
main_screens.title: Keep a good thing going.
main_screens.copy: New connections and conversations in one place. A photo and an age are enough to get started.
main_screens.ruleCopy: No subscription is needed to chat after matching.

main_screens.name: Conversation
main_screens.title: Start with a hello.
main_screens.copy: High-contrast message bubbles, a clean composer and safety controls a tap away.
main_screens.ruleCopy: Exact encounter locations and times stay out of the conversation.

main_screens.name: Your profile
main_screens.title: Make it yours.
main_screens.copy: Your age, identity, four photos and preferences. Manage visibility, Premium and the How it works introduction from one place.
main_screens.ruleCopy: No name, job, religion or biography required.

main_screens.name: Location & visibility
main_screens.title: You set the pace.
main_screens.copy: Update frequency, reveal delay and a visibility switch together. Simple choices, clear defaults.
main_screens.ruleCopy: If one person chooses one hour and the other two, both wait two hours.
